dog.description_text:
Pop Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Volt!
Volt is a lively, people loving guy who brings plenty of energy wherever he goes! Found as a stray, this handsome boy is still a bit of a mystery, but he's already shown us that he loves meeting people, playing with toys, and getting everyone involved in whatever fun he's having. With Volt around, life is never dull, and he's ready to power up his next chapter with a family of his own!

My Ideal Home
Volt would love an active home where he can enjoy plenty of walks, playtime, and adventures with his favorite people. He's an enthusiastic guy who will benefit from daily exercise, food puzzles, long lasting chews, and fun training games to keep his mind busy. He's got plenty of energy to share, and a family who enjoys helping a playful pup learn new skills will be a great match for him.

Good with Other Pets?
Volt showed no response to other dogs while walking at ACC, but we are still learning about his history with other animals. Any introductions with resident pets should be slow and thoughtful to help everyone get comfortable.

Good with Kids?
Volt would do best in a home without children under 5 because he can get very excited when meeting people. Older children who are comfortable around an energetic dog may be a better fit, with adults helping him practice polite greetings.

Things to Know
Volt is a social, playful guy who loves to jump up and say hello. He can pull hard on leash, so he'll benefit from patient practice and positive reinforcement to help him build better walking manners. He also gets enthusiastic during toy play, but he responds well to redirection. With a little training and plenty of outlets for his energy, Volt will be ready to bring a whole new spark to his forever home!
dog.name: Volt
